# tcpshield_sentry_tunnel_locations (Data Source)

Lists the locations a Sentry tunnel can be placed in.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "tcpshield_sentry_tunnel_locations" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `keys` (List of String) The location keys, sorted.
- `locations` (Map of String) Location key → display name, e.g. `ANY = "Anycast"`.
